result:
M05 round 1 **passes**. Every check passed on the real stack, I made no fixes, and there are no FIX tasks or M05 contract issues. I wrote the verdict file last.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Review (`git diff HEAD` + untracked) | Pass: every ticked task (T060–T075) exists in the code and matches the contract and constitution |
| Swagger vs contract | Pass |
| `./mvnw -q verify` | Pass: 159 tests, 0 failures |
| `ng build` | Pass, with the usual 500 kB bundle budget warning |
| curl M01–M05 (fresh database) | Pass: 61 of 61 cases |
| M05 browser scenarios E2E-M05-01 to 09 | Pass |
| Smoke scenarios from M01–M04 | Pass |

The M05 browser run:
- **Empty state:** checked first on the fresh database.
- **Real-clock start:** a plan starting about a minute ahead went from Not started to In progress, and the time left counted down.
- **Start banner:** shown once per plan, with exactly one acknowledge call each. With notifications off there was no banner, but the plan was still acknowledged.
- **Ticking items:** ticking the task item set the task to Done and un-ticking set it back to To do. Ticking the habit item created no habit completion. Ticking all items brought the plan to 100% and moved it to History.
- **Delete:** works with the confirm dialog, and the task, habit and card are kept.
- **Backend down:** the plans page shows an error message rather than a false empty state.

Small issues for later, none blocking:
- The plan status changes up to 30 seconds after the start time, because the page reloads every 30 seconds.
- The catch-up banner says "has started" even for plans that have already ended.
- The plan builder dialog's right edge is slightly cut off at 1440 px wide.

Two commands were blocked because this headless session can't approve them: a curl call with quoted variable text, and a copy using a wildcard. I made the same API calls through the browser instead. The screenshots therefore stay in `run-artifacts/playwright/` and were not copied into the evidence folder.

I restarted the backend on port 8090 with a fresh database for curl. It is still running, and the frontend on 4300 is untouched. I did not commit anything.

- `outputs/evidence/M05/round-1/` (`e2e-result.md`, `curl.log`, Swagger diff)
